product_overview: Caffenia is an immersive coffee e-commerce and brand experience platform that blends a premium shop with cinematic storytelling and interactive visuals. It enables browsing, wishlist/cart management, event bookings, and checkout flows within a motion-driven, responsive UI.
core_goals: Provide a frictionless product discovery and shopping experience for coffee products
Offer immersive brand storytelling with scroll-driven and 3D visual experiences
Support basic commerce flows (cart, checkout, order confirmation) persisted in-browser
Surface events and enable client-side booking and contact interactions
Maintain a responsive, motion-rich UI with smooth navigation across pages

features.name: Home Page Navigation
features.description: Surface brand visuals, featured collections, and primary navigation to key areas of the site.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View hero section with brand visuals -> View featured product collection sections -> Use navigation to go to /shop -> See shop listing
Navigate to / -> Attempt to open slide-out cart -> See empty cart state when no items are present

features.name: Product Shopping
features.description: Browse product listings, filter by category, view detailed product pages, add items to cart, and toggle wishlist.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> Browse product grid on shop page -> Filter products by choosing a category -> Navigate to /category/:id -> Select a product to view details -> Navigate to /coffeeDetail/:id -> View product images carousel -> Add product to cart -> See cart updated with the added item
Navigate to /shop -> Filter or search resulting in no matches -> See empty results state on the shop or category page

features.name: Shopping Cart Management
features.description: View cart contents, adjust quantities, remove items, and proceed toward checkout using a dedicated cart page or slide-out cart panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> View all cart items with quantities and prices -> Increase or decrease quantity for an item -> Observe cart total update accordingly -> Proceed to checkout -> Navigate to /payment
Navigate to /cart -> Remove items until cart is empty -> See empty cart message and blocked checkout action

features.name: Checkout and Payment
features.description: Collect shipping and payment details and submit an order to receive an on-site order confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /payment -> Fill in first name and last name -> Fill in email address -> Fill in shipping address fields -> Fill in card number, expiry date, CVV -> Submit payment form -> Navigate to /thankyou and see order confirmation
Navigate to /payment -> Attempt to submit with missing or invalid required fields -> See form validation errors and prevent submission

features.name: User Account and Wishlist
features.description: Allow users to view their account overview and manage a client-side wishlist of products.
user_flows: Navigate to /account -> View account profile section -> Open wishlist tab -> View saved products in wishlist -> Remove an item from wishlist -> See wishlist update
Navigate to /account -> Open wishlist tab after clearing browser storage -> See empty wishlist state

features.name: Product Search
features.description: Search products by name or keyword and navigate from results to product details.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> Type search query in search input -> View filtered search results -> Select a search result -> Navigate to /coffeeDetail/:id and view product details
Navigate to /search -> Type a query with no matching products -> See no results / empty search state

features.name: Events Listing and Detail
features.description: Browse upcoming events, view event details, and submit client-side bookings for experiences and workshops.
user_flows: Navigate to /events -> View list of upcoming events -> Select an event to view details -> Navigate to /events/:id -> Fill booking form with name, email, and number of attendees -> Submit booking form -> See local booking confirmation
Navigate to /events -> Open an event detail -> Submit booking form with missing required fields -> See form validation errors preventing submission

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Send a message to the brand via an on-site contact form and receive an immediate on-page confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in name field -> Fill in email field -> Fill in message textarea -> Submit contact form -> See success confirmation message
Navigate to /contact -> Attempt to submit with empty required fields -> See validation errors and prevent submission

features.name: About and Brand Story
features.description: Read the brand story and experience the scroll-driven narrative and media-rich story page.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Scroll through brand story sections -> Navigate to /story -> Experience the scroll-driven coffee story
Navigate to /story -> Media or 3D content fails to initialize -> See fallback static content or explanatory placeholder

features.name: Reviews Page
features.description: Read customer reviews and ratings presented as a scrollable list of review cards.
user_flows: Navigate to /reviews -> View customer review cards with ratings and comments -> Scroll through review list
Navigate to /reviews -> See no reviews available -> See empty reviews state

features.name: Social / Instagram Gallery
features.description: Browse a gallery of social media style photo cards and view images in larger detail when supported.
user_flows: Navigate to /social -> View grid of Instagram-style photo cards -> Open a photo for a larger view if supported
Navigate to /social -> Image assets fail to load -> See image placeholders or fallback visuals

features.name: Terms and Conditions
features.description: Provide the platform's terms, privacy policy, and a navigable table of contents for users to read legal text.
user_flows: Navigate to /terms -> Scroll and read terms sections -> Use table of contents links to jump to a specific section
Navigate to /terms -> Attempt to jump to a missing anchor via table of contents -> See fallback behavior and remain at the top or nearest available section

known_limitations.issue: No real backend API; all data (products, events, orders) is stored locally in constants.ts and localStorage
known_limitations.impact: Cart, wishlist, and order history only persist in browser localStorage; no server-side persistence

known_limitations.issue: Payment form is UI-only and does not connect to a real payment gateway
known_limitations.impact: Submitting payment does not charge any card; it only navigates to thank you page

known_limitations.issue: Contact form submission is UI-only with no backend email service connected
known_limitations.impact: Messages are not actually sent anywhere

known_limitations.issue: Event booking form is UI-only with no backend persistence
known_limitations.impact: Booking submissions are not stored or confirmed server-side
